description: Probability-decision MCQs for native ADJ prior/contributes/observe/query programs. Each item gives candidate hypotheses, priors, observed evidence, and likelihood ratios; the gold decomposition is a native ADJ program, and the harness maps decision.leader to categorical options.

items.stem: Two diagnoses start with prior 0.30 each: bacterial and viral. Observed evidence is csf(neutrophilic). That evidence has likelihood ratio 15 for bacterial and 1.2 for viral. Which diagnosis leads?
items.program:
prior 0.30 for bacterial
prior 0.30 for viral
contributes 15 from csf(neutrophilic) to bacterial
contributes 1.2 from csf(neutrophilic) to viral
observe csf(neutrophilic)
? bacterial
? viral
